text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD #INC-12345 - inference-gateway-usw2 5xx rate spike (5m avg 6.3% > 5% threshold). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-12345. Signal: http_5xx_rate. Hosts: kv-proxy-*. Region: usw2. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/d/alerts/5xx-rate
eric: Acked. I'm oncall, jumping in.
sre_anna: Can someone post customer impact quickly? Are whole requests failing or partial degradation?
dave: Quick summary from logs: 502s with "upstream reset by peer" concentrated on kv-proxy nodes. Traffic pattern shows retries amplifying the spike. Failure rate climbed from ~0.6% -> 6% in ~6m.
lina: Quick curl test shows 502 reproducible: ```curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}'``` Response: 502, header `X-Upstream: kv-proxy-1`.
eric: Starting canary restart of kv-proxy-1 now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy -n inference --selector=instance=kv-proxy-1` I'll watch metrics.
pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to eric. Escalation policy: SRE rotation. Next escalation in 10m if unacknowledged.
megan: If restart doesn't fully stop it, we should enable fallback routing for critical customer traffic to origin pool. I can flip the flag: `flags set fallback-origin=true` (will do only if needed).
dave: After the restart, kv-proxy-1 502s decreased. Cluster 5xx dropped to ~1.4% within 2m. Still seeing occasional 502s pinned to kv-proxy-3.
sre_anna: Can we scale kv-proxy replicas to absorb connection pressure? `kubectl scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=6 -n inference`
eric: Scaling to 6 replicas now. Also throttling client retry bursts at the gateway to avoid amplification.
lina: From support queue: a small subset of customers saw elevated latencies but no data loss. I'm drafting a short status for support: https://confluence.redwood/inbox/INC-12345
dave: Root cause likely connection pool exhaustion + a small leak in upstream keepalive. I'll push a patch to canary after this stabilizes. Monitoring window 15m.
eric: PD note: triaged -> mitigation applied (restart + scale + fallback on standby). Lowering severity to P2.
incident-bot: Alert resolved: 5xx rate back to baseline (0.4%). Incident auto-closed by eric. PD INC-12345 -> resolved.
megan: Thanks team. I'll open a postmortem and schedule a follow-up to review the kv-proxy connection handling.
eric: Thanks all :thumbsup:
